observed_events.description: While chopping potatoes, the wearer faces a green oblong rectangular cutting board on the right and a dark round cooking pan with one long handle on the hob to the left. Both are plausible spare-kitchen-item referents.

source.scope_note: Position is relative to the wearer during this released chopping interval, not the whole three-minute recording. The old toaster annotation is not visual evidence.

supported_claims.text: A rectangular cutting board remains on the wearer's right and a round handled pan on the left throughout the released chopping interval. Exact brand, dimensions, material and colour are not requirements.

construct.research_question: Can the Agent resolve a natural spatial reference between two real kitchen items and buy a practical spare rather than the wrong object, accessory or pack?

task_blueprint.ambiguous_instruction: I'd like a spare of one of these two kitchen items, the cutting board or the cooking pan. Add a single one with a working surface of the same general shape to the cart, not a set. Any brand, colour, material or size is fine.
task_blueprint.oracle_instruction: I'd like a spare of the kitchen item on my right, out of the cutting board and cooking pan. Add a single one with a working surface of the same general shape to the cart, not a set. Any brand, colour, material or size is fine.
task_blueprint.canonical_question: Do you mean the item on your left or on your right?
task_blueprint.completion_claim: Exactly one oblong rectangular cutting board from all verified alternatives in the final cart. Pan depth, board handle shape, folds, brand, material, colour and dimensions are not hidden constraints.

observed.why: The answer gives only wearer-relative right; the released scene links right to the board, not to a product name.

catalogue_assessment.rule: One individual board with an oblong rectangular working surface; ordinary lids, serving use, folded lips, hanging holes and end handles do not disqualify an otherwise useful board. Exclude multi-board or tableware packages, square working surfaces and standalone holders. Rounded corners are acceptable. A double-sided board pictured from both sides is one board, not a set. No exact model or colour matching. A single board with an apparently rectangular main working surface remains acceptable when it adds holding fixtures; no unsupported square dimensions are inferred. Shape refers to the working surface, not a projecting handle or fixture.
catalogue_assessment.evidence: Both complete 48-result native pages, all 96 public listing images and titles screened; shared real products deduplicated by ASIN. Independent review found the general-shape modifier ambiguous and the square claim for p_97def538980c unsupported. The former is clarified in both public instructions; the latter is accepted as a practical substitute from its visible rectangular board rather than excluded without evidence.

construct.belief_before: Either the visible cutting board or the visible cooking pan could be the requested spare.
construct.belief_after: The right-hand referent is the cutting board; choose one practical board with an oblong rectangular working surface.
construct.required_behavior_change: Use the wearer-relative spatial answer to choose the board and leave no pan or extra item in the final cart.
construct.no_update_failure: Guess the pan or retain ambiguity without using the available answer.
construct.overupdate_failure: Buy both kitchen items, or impose an unrequested exact colour, material or brand.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The answer names only right. The physical view is needed to link that direction to the board; both referent families exist in the real search window. A single well-aimed frame may suffice, which is acceptable for this static-reference control.

screening.source_observations: Native 480x360 source, entire three-minute contact sheet and all eight released views screened. The 20–23.5-second chopping interval keeps both spatial referents visible. Canonical parent is independent of all current formal recordings.

changes: Clarified that the general shape applies to the working surface, not the whole handle outline.
Accepted p_97def538980c; removed unsupported square-surface rejection.
repair.retained_evidence: Unchanged eight source frames, physical spatial referents, clarification answer, real website facts and original blind primary state. Only these answer/wording boundaries need follow-up.

repair_history.reason: Preserve all source frames, timestamps, release times, requests and goals. Apply the tested rendering setting uniformly across models and affected conditions.
